statements.text: Use autonomous runtime as the primary cycle-speed metric.
Report calendar elapsed time separately from autonomous runtime.
Report mean, p50, p90, sample count, attribution coverage, and unavailable count.
Aggregate host and configured VM sources with explicit per-source availability.
Do not remove, weaken, skip, or infer any required quality or safety evidence.
Permit only benchmark-qualified concurrency with equivalent gate evidence and no added remediation.
Keep timing and trend evidence private, bounded, sanitized, and source-local until federation.
Avoid repeated full OpenCode database scans when reporting cycle trends.
Remediate DKS query lock contention and repeated fallback failures without weakening source verification.
Do not add a tracing backend, hosted telemetry service, or new workflow engine.
Use the approved lifecycle, OpenCode control-plane, distribution, and DKS context map.
Historical calendar and sparse phase timing are not an autonomous-runtime baseline.
Provide a reusable report-only skill that audits cycle performance without requiring a bespoke prompt.
Ground audits in sanitized cycle, session, incident, and telemetry evidence while keeping raw session content private.
Catalogue measured bottlenecks and obvious unmeasured bloat separately across the complete lifecycle.
Use Scout and Explore only for independent evidence gaps, keep private telemetry local, and never create generic reviewer work.
Treat DKS contention, incident scans, and telemetry timeouts as auditable performance and reliability defects with bounded fallback.
Prioritize opportunities by impact, frequency, confidence, effort, and quality risk, with explicit acceptance measurements.
Do not claim causality from reviewer, model, token, or elapsed-time associations without comparable cohorts.
Reuse exact validation evidence and affected-scope selection where equivalent instead of rerunning unchanged authorities.
Federated trend audits must use immutable captures and explicit source availability instead of repeated live rescans.
The audit skill does not mutate review markers, incidents, cycle state, gates, claims, or optimization activation.
Serve the prior policy-valid active DKS projection while reconciliation builds a replacement, and atomically restore baseline ranking when activation invalidates quality policy.
Return bounded typed DKS availability from OpenCode within one shared five-second deadline without exposing raw errors or converting unavailable retrieval into citations.
Repository runtime recovery does not claim to repair upstream OpenCode parallel-batch finalization or system-reminder rendering.
Exhausted DKS activation contention exits 75, emits only projection_busy, returns no citations, and remains machine-classifiable by the OpenCode adapter.
DKS lock acquisition and one policy-repair attempt share a two-second total deadline with deterministic partial-lock cleanup.
Performance audits record fixed source identity, Method Revision, sanitized filters, evidence availability, cohort composition, and deterministic nearest-rank reductions.
History telemetry supports page-first aggregate-only output without candidate bodies or identifiers.
Incident Scan supports bounded summary output by allowlisted tool, failure class, and recovery state while preserving overflow truth.
OpenCode bounds History and Incident subprocesses and returns typed availability without exposing raw failures.
Hosted Explore claims that an artifact is absent require primary fixed-object verification.

History aggregate and Incident summary modes use exact versioned schemas, bounded allowlists, explicit unavailable denominators, hidden-identity digest binding, transient read-side capture semantics, and truthful 100-row overflow.

Use DKS as one optional accelerator only for broad questions in configured projects; exact-path, fixed-commit, unconfigured-project, unavailable, and stale-revision work proceeds directly to authoritative source inspection.

One DKS attempt shares one five-second monotonic end-to-end deadline across adapter, subprocess, privacy, lock, embedding, database, and ranking work, then returns typed unavailability without automatic retry.
Only project- and revision-compatible DKS citations may guide source inspection, and successful output remains bounded to at most ten citations.

DKS privacy guarding uses a dedicated lifecycle privacy lock so unrelated History, Incident, review, and capture work cannot block retrieval while forget and expiry mutations still cannot race cited result completion.
Automatic DKS routing must pass a paired fixed-source comparison against direct authoritative inspection covering completion latency, citation correctness, tool errors, tool calls, and token cost.

Automatic DKS routing remains enabled only with no correctness regression, no added tool errors, hard p95 below five seconds, and at least ten percent lower paired median completion time; failure disables automatic routing without retiring the rebuildable projection or manual CLI.

DKS recovery and value evidence records only bounded sanitized availability and stage-duration classes without query text, citation bodies, paths, process identities, lock identities, credentials, or raw errors.

History and Incident population discovery uses an owner-private rebuildable boundary index that preserves exact source ordering, atomic readiness, privacy invalidation, and explicit unavailability without storing source bodies.

Ready aggregate History and Incident summary reads use a body-free schema-version-3 materialized snapshot for membership, source-heavy metrics, safe categories, and failure/recovery classification so representative warm p95 stays below thirty seconds without weakening exact output or privacy semantics.

Projection refresh reads message and part authority in one immutable SQLite transaction, retains only session aggregates and material boundary/tool rows, and atomically replaces the prior snapshot after privacy, integrity, size, and source validation.

An explicitly enabled low-priority single-flight host job refreshes the History projection daily at 04:30, preserves the prior snapshot on failure, exposes bounded freshness, and supports safe disablement and rollback.
Historical reporting validates stored record structure independently of live checkout availability; missing historical worktrees never authorize execution or make malformed records valid.
Deliver the remaining cycle-speed slices serially in the invoking primary without spawned agents or sessions; specify but defer concurrency implementation and activation.
Keep refresh timeout at or below sixty minutes and continue serving an integrity- and privacy-valid prior snapshot with explicit age while background refresh recovers.
Reconcile existing delivery and preserve unmerged work before replacement; adjacent Codex and unrelated pull requests remain ownership-review inputs rather than implementation scope.
Administrator merge is permitted only after required gates and CI pass, expected head is verified, and the feature branch is current with its protected base; no failed evidence is waived.

The scheduler wrapper owns bounded machine-safe run state with a status surface and enforces the hard timeout by terminating its own refresh process group; launchd fires a missed calendar run at most once at wake and host enablement happens during cycle validation.

Scheduler status persists only one owner-private atomic latest-run summary and exposes one exact bounded JSON schema; missing state is never_run while unsafe or invalid state fails closed without output.
When the master knowledge-store flag is false, no DKS route, tool, job, process, runtime target, config, key, cache, or log remains active; subordinate settings cannot override it.

Retire DKS state irreversibly without backup after runtime disablement: drop only the dedicated database and role, delete proven DKS private and model state plus credentials, and preserve shared PM, Graphify, ambiguous assets, Git, and Cycle Records.
DKS re-enable remains blocked until a future separately approved controlled-environment design defines an environment receipt; enabled=true alone cannot activate the retired production feature.
Defer DKS optimization, privacy-isolation, runtime-recovery, and routing-value work while the feature is retired; continue non-DKS performance work without treating disabled retrieval as zero.
Retirement unloads before deletion, stays disabled on partial failure, emits bounded residual classes, and never rolls back by restarting DKS.

State retirement removes the dedicated DKS database plus login and owner roles, verified DKS-owned state children and model namespaces, exact manifest-owned mixed-root children, host/vault credentials, logs, and subordinate machine settings while retaining the nested PM baseline subtree and every unlisted or identity-mismatched asset.

Preserve knowledge/postgres recursively and its required parent in place; retire only verified DKS-owned siblings, never recursively delete the knowledge root, and do not classify protected PM baselines as residual DKS state. PM baseline helper paths and behavior remain unchanged.
Preserve harness routes, permissions, defaults, public CLI/schema compatibility, privacy, required evidence and gate decisions while optimizing internal work.
Compute session-family components once per request and preserve exact-session and family correlation semantics.
Reduce unrelated page enrichment and duplicate capture parsing while retaining complete required integrity validation.
Apply one shared monotonic budget to optional local telemetry collection and preserve original command outcomes on unavailable capture.
Bound Incident candidate materialization while preserving recovery ordering, disposition filtering and truthful overflow.
Reuse repository and continuation metadata only within a qualified read operation, never across mutation authority boundaries.
Provide deterministic public synthetic Python profiling and benchmark fixtures without new runtime dependencies or private-store access.
Report paired baseline and candidate performance with exact source/runtime/workload identity, coverage, failures and no inferred whole-cycle gain.
Correct diagnostic overlap and distinguish automatic operation categories from demonstrated repeated work without fabricating attribution.
Evaluate startup optimizations only within existing standalone, source identity, import and sibling-helper compatibility; reject an incompatible package split.
Validate committed benchmark fixture dependency closure without invoking optimization activation.
Evaluate duplicate CI execution using unchanged required checks, runtime matrix, early publication authority and exact unique test coverage.
Reconcile stale source-delivery labels and dependencies across existing Initiatives and specifications without claiming runtime qualification.
Do not activate native analytics, federation, DKS, concurrency, shadow execution, new model routing or formal advisory gate-evidence admission.
Deliver the lifecycle performance core as one source-only draft PR with serial ownership of the shared executable and tests.
Keep helper operation timing separate from full-primary autonomous coverage and native actor attribution; preserve local-only quiet paths.
Preserve existing retention and records; workflow-event pruning or private-state migration is outside this source tranche.
Use existing project-selected Python dependencies and quality authorities; do not introduce an installed profiler or tracing service.
Startup modularization touches standalone relocation and executable-source authority; broader packaging requires reopened readiness.
Source index unavailability remains explicit; no implicit refresh, raw-source fallback or installed-runtime claim follows from synthetic success.
Distribution owns hosted validation execution changes; lifecycle supplies baseline/protocol and retains the early-publication contract. Preserve all unique required tests and existing job semantics.
Deliver reusable opt-in Python benchmark tooling and a versioned evidence format before selecting optimizations.
Lifecycle owns common protocol and CLI baselines, distribution owns retained-CI analysis, and continuous-validation owns isolated snapshot-memory measurements; DKS measurements are deferred.
Use disposable local synthetic fixtures plus retained CI evidence only; do not dispatch fresh measurement jobs or profile live host services.
Bind source, toolchain, fixture, cache and instrumentation identities to all attempts; retain failures and unavailable metrics separately from descriptive statistics.
Measure whole-process CLI startup and use separate instrumented cohorts for Git subprocess counts and profiles without production helper edits.
Parse retained CI durations with provenance and exact lane identities; distinguish queue, setup and execution, and never infer unique coverage from test counts.
Measure synthetic snapshot workloads across selected-byte/history shapes and one or two isolated controllers; distinguish qualified process RSS from Python allocations and total host memory.
Preserve source immutability, public behavior, gate/authority decisions, privacy, installed runtime defaults and existing production resource/admission contracts.
Keep raw profiles, retained logs and runtime evidence private; publish only generic tooling and synthetic fixtures through the existing public-content authority.
Use existing project-selected dependencies, runtimes and quality authorities; record unconfigured typing and unsupported measurement capabilities without installing tools or claiming a pass.

Deliver the common CLI baseline before the CI and snapshot consumers; existing lifecycle optimization requires its CLI precursor and CI optimization requires retained-CI evidence as well as performance-core delivery.
Accept baseline tooling through deterministic correctness, isolation and truthful evidence tests; incomplete measurement remains partial and no speedup threshold applies to baseline delivery.
Apply explicit child, total-time, output/input and scratch-size bounds, record cancellation/failure and reap owned work before continuing; never replay uncertain work automatically.
Do not execute DKS models or services, access private stores, activate workers, optimize production code, change hosted workflows or create a runtime/typing migration in PY-09.
OS cache/load, profiling overhead, source drift, platform resource units and retained-CI format differences can prevent comparability; report unavailable or inconclusive rather than invent values.
Retain existing context profiles, source-only plans, README/CHANGELOG review, full document import closure and fresh receipt/preflight/approval for each serial source slice.
